## Agreed scope

Launch one pinned published calculator image through my existing Docker/Traefik
server, or explicitly verify/adopt a matching existing deployment. Preserve
unrelated services. No application source clone, proxy replacement or required
update/rollback exercise.

## Evidence to link

- [ ] SPEC.md records the agreed target and whether this was a new launch or adoption.
- [ ] Prepared checks and CI have actual results; skipped/unrun checks stay explicit.
- [ ] Sanitized runtime/public-release evidence and my own browser observation are linked.
- [ ] LEARNING.md records actual contributions/help/gaps and has been reviewed before publication.
- [ ] The PR, latest CI and final keep/revise decision are linked.
